question:
PC Mahalanobis is remembered as a major contributor of India’s developmental path because he __________.

(A) set up Indian Institutes of Management located in different parts of India

(B) formulated the Second Five-Year Plan

(C) was the first Minister of Statistics and Programme Implementation
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PC Mahalanobis** is remembered as a major contributor to India's developmental path because he **formulated the Second Five-Year Plan**.
 
• He was a pioneer in the field of statistics and played a crucial role in the establishment of the Indian Statistical Institute.
